addresses.name: CGraphicalTableLedger_FillRows
addresses.comment: Rebuilds the on-screen rows from the current scroll position: `(int)(slider value + 0.5)` is the first row of the table's sorted row vector (+0x24), each cell a TableItemText (or an icon, or an icon with a flag `ledger_nation_flag` named after the column). **Rows step by the first cell rectangle's height (30), from its top (35), until past the area (+0x11C), which is `ledger_LR`.y: sixteen.** A row's first element gets `ledger_flags` and the row's rectangle (+0x104) so a click finds it. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topscreens.md, section B.10.
addresses.revises: there is no `ledger_row_height` in the image; the step is the first cell rectangle's height

addresses.name: CGraphicalTableLedger::CGraphicalTableLedger
addresses.no_signature: the object is the first stack argument; followed by columns, gui, graphics, parent, ledger, UL, LR, and positions; ret 0x48
addresses.comment: Constructs a 0x150-byte CGraphicalTableLedger: the table (+0x74), gui (+0x70), graphics (+0xC8), two 0x12C-byte C2dObject backgrounds (+0xCC, +0xD0 - the header and the body), the column rectangles (+0xD4 headers, +0xF4 cells) passed in by the page, the slider standardlistbox_slider (+0x128) placed by `ledger_scrollbar_offset`, a slider observer. Each column's header is the optional named icon at the rectangle's corner and a `TableHeaderText` after the icon's width, its width set to the rectangle's, and parked off screen when its text is empty; the header row is built here, the data rows by 0x392B70 (FillRows). Built by every table page. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topscreens.md, section B.10.
addresses.revises: the rectangles are the page's and do not come from `ledger_UL`; the header's text sits after the icon

addresses.name: LedgerPage_StrategicResources
addresses.signature: void __stdcall LedgerPage_StrategicResources(CStatisticsLedger* ledger, int pageOfTwo, int firstResource, int lastResource)
addresses.comment: Ledger pages 9 and 10 (`PW_STRAT_RESOURCES`): columns are the strategic resources from `firstResource` up to `lastResource` (page 9: 0..8, page 10: 9.. to the end, -1 meaning all), each headed by an icon `ledger_<name>_icon` and its name, each (ledger_UL.x + 18) x 2 / columns wide. **Row r holds the r-th province of each column's resource**, from CCurrentGameState::strategic_resource_provinces; a cell's text is `@<holder tag> <province name>`, its tooltip 'resource controlled by <country> (<faction>) located at province <name>' (LEDGER_STRAT_RES_CONTROL_TOOLTIP_1, _2), the faction green for the player's own, red for another, white when the player has none. The rows are keyed by number and left unsorted. See reversing/findings/FINDINGS-topscreens.md, section B.10.
addresses.revises: a row is an index into each resource's list and not a province; the cell is text with a flag; the header has words as well as the icon
